Relative, workspace (`~/<workspace>/...`, `/Users/<me>/<workspace>/...`), and `/tmp` paths are allowed. A path outside those safe zones -- arbitrary absolute (`/etc/...`), bare `~`, or `..` traversal -- is rejected for scope control: it can flood context with an unbounded scan. To read one known file by an out-of-zone absolute path use the Read tool. Pipeline filters on bounded stdout stay allowed (`... | grep pat`).
